answer: One strong defense is to anchor every agent identity to a scarce, slashable stake that grows only with honest work, like a grove where each tree must be planted and tended before it bears fruit. A newcomer starts as a lone island with no reputation and no access to high-value jobs, so creating thousands of fake identities means paying thousands of separate stakes plus months of verifiable history. A Sybil flood thus becomes expensive and slow instead of free.
